detailed_descriptions.en: Zero programming required! A tool for anyone to create RPGs "RPG Developer Bakin" (hereafter 'Bakin') is a tool that makes it easy to create various types of RPGs, adventure games and action games without any programming knowledge. Create a "world" as if you were playing a game! Fun and highly functional map editor Maps, which are the stages of games, are easy to create, just like drawing a picture with a pen. Simply raise or lower the ground and place plants, trees, houses and furniture. You can freely change the position, scale and rotation of the placed objects! You can also customize models by combining objects such as houses, windows, and balconies to create your own unique world. Create stunning scenes quickly and easily! Advanced visual expression Advanced visual expressions such as blurring distant scenery or changing the lighting of an entire screen are easily achieved with Bakin's post-effects capabilities. Other tools include a toon shader for creating a cartoon-like look, a mask function for hiding parts of an image, and a decal function for applying 2D assets like stickers. We encourage you to pursue your own visual image to the fullest! Simply arrange the panels! Event editor without programming Creating games with Bakin requires zero programming knowledge. By simply combining various "event panels" such as "have a conversation," "change character position," and "branch by choice," you can easily create events and control the game. In addition, common events such as "join a group," "receive an item," and "move between maps" can be used immediately with just a few modifications to the included templates. Screen designs are also customizable! Various tools to support game creation Bakin's layout tool allows you to freely customize the game screen interface. Various tools support your game creation, such as a database for detailed character and item settings and a camera tool for dynamic game play. Assets & Samples to start creating games immediately Various assets to enhance the game setting and storyline, such as 2D/3D graphical assets for characters and buildings, particle effects, sound data, etc., are available as bundled or exclusive free DLCs. In addition, you can create a richer world by installing DLCs sold separately. Of course, you can also import and use your own 3D models, pixel characters, illustrations and sounds. It's also possible to write plug-ins in C# to extend the functionality of the tool. You can distribute your games royalty-free, whether they are paid or free. Now turn "your idea of the world" into a game with Bakin!

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Zero programming required! A tool for anyone to create RPGs

"RPG Developer Bakin" (hereafter 'Bakin') is a tool that makes it easy to create various types of RPGs, adventure games and action games without any programming knowledge.

Create a "world" as if you were playing a game! Fun and highly functional map editor

Maps, which are the stages of games, are easy to create, just like drawing a picture with a pen.

Simply raise or lower the ground and place plants, trees, houses and furniture. You can freely change the position, scale and rotation of the placed objects! You can also customize models by combining objects such as houses, windows, and balconies to create your own unique world.

Create stunning scenes quickly and easily! Advanced visual expression

Advanced visual expressions such as blurring distant scenery or changing the lighting of an entire screen are easily achieved with Bakin's post-effects capabilities.

Other tools include a toon shader for creating a cartoon-like look, a mask function for hiding parts of an image, and a decal function for applying 2D assets like stickers. We encourage you to pursue your own visual image to the fullest!

Simply arrange the panels! Event editor without programming

Creating games with Bakin requires zero programming knowledge.

By simply combining various "event panels" such as "have a conversation," "change character position," and "branch by choice," you can easily create events and control the game. In addition, common events such as "join a group," "receive an item," and "move between maps" can be used immediately with just a few modifications to the included templates.

Screen designs are also customizable! Various tools to support game creation

Bakin's layout tool allows you to freely customize the game screen interface. Various tools support your game creation, such as a database for detailed character and item settings and a camera tool for dynamic game play.

Assets & Samples to start creating games immediately

Various assets to enhance the game setting and storyline, such as 2D/3D graphical assets for characters and buildings, particle effects, sound data, etc., are available as bundled or exclusive free DLCs.

In addition, you can create a richer world by installing DLCs sold separately. Of course, you can also import and use your own 3D models, pixel characters, illustrations and sounds.

It's also possible to write plug-ins in C# to extend the functionality of the tool. You can distribute your games royalty-free, whether they are paid or free.

Now turn "your idea of the world" into a game with Bakin!
